display.purpose: Command words typed in the palette (Configure, SDK) when used as tabs; 24px below 600px.

body.purpose: Table cells, notes and descriptions; descriptions capped at 70ch.

label.purpose: Column headers, field labels, switch labels, small buttons; sentence case.

code.purpose: URLs, paths and identifiers only, always LTR.

shadows.name: floating-edge
shadows.purpose: Leading edge of the side drawer; mirrored in RTL. Only overlays lift.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: The status toast floating at the bottom of the page.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Solid scrim fill behind a modal drawer or the version dialog; no blur.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: The palette version dialog floating over the scrim.

motion.name: tab-bar
motion.purpose: Signal bar sliding to the newly selected command tab.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: Side drawer opening from the inline-end edge.

motion.name: rows-fade
motion.purpose: New rows after a tab switch fade in once, as a whole.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per view (Add option, Save option).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 13.5px/1 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; background: #1d2547; border: 1px solid #1d2547; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c3766; border-color: #2c3766; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f51c2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action: Cancel, Edit, View, Previous, Next.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 600 13.5px/1 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: #1d2547; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c9cedb; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f4f5f9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f51c2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with help text below.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font: 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2547; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; font: inherit; color: #1d2547; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c9cedb; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3f51c2; outline: 2px solid #3f51c2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-help { font-size: 12px; color: #5b6482; }

components.name: Command Tabs
components.description: The command words as tabs, with a Signal bar under the selected one.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde1eb; } .ds-tab { padding: 0 0 8px; font: 600 28px/1.15 Bahnschrift, "DIN Alternate", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #5b6482; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 transparent; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1d2547; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: #1d2547; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #3f51c2; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f51c2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tabn { margin-inline-start: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #5b6482; vertical-align: 0.9em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Built-in Badge
components.description: Marks a Built-in Option beside its name.
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 1px 6px; font: 600 11.5px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5b6482; background: #f4f5f9; border: 1px solid #dde1eb; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Active Switch
components.description: Turns an option on or off; indigo when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; font: 600 12.5px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2547; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 34px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #c3c8d6; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: inset-inline-start 0.15s; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track { background: #3f51c2; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track::after { inset-inline-start: 16px; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-track { outline: 2px solid #3f51c2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Table Sheet
components.description: One flat white sheet holding the options table.
components.css: .ds-sheet { overflow: clip; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dde1eb; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2547; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table th { padding: 10px 16px; text-align: start; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #5b6482; background: #f8f9fc; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde1eb; } .ds-table td { padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde1eb; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f7f8fc; } .ds-name { font-weight: 600; } .ds-target { color: #5b6482; font: 12.5px/1.45 Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", monospace; direction: ltr; }

components.name: Verb Mark
components.description: A palette command row with its verb colour on the 20px icon only.
components.css: .ds-verb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 28px; padding: 3px 6px; font: 14px "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d2547; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 5px; } .ds-verb-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
AxiCMD is a precise tool that stays out of the way. It lives inside the Axpert shell, next to Axpert's own forms and reports, so it never competes with its host: surfaces are flat, white and thinly ruled, the density is that of a working admin tool, and almost everything is ink on paper. The work is done by type and by one signal colour. The words a user types (the command verbs such as Configure and SDK) are the only element allowed to be large.

Colour is information, never decoration. Console Ink means "read this" or "press this"; Signal Indigo means "this is selected or switched on". Each palette verb keeps its own small colour mark so users learn to recognise commands at a glance. Motion appears only in answer to something the user did: a drawer sliding in, the selected-tab bar moving, rows fading in after a change.

An earlier frosted-glass look with an amber-to-coral gradient has been retired. Every AxiCMD surface now follows this system, including the palette's gear menu, the "Records per load" panel and the version dialog (`axicmdmain.css` sections 8 and 9).
keyCharacteristics: Flat white sheets on a cool paper page, separated by 1px rules.
One signal colour (indigo) for state; navy ink for text and actions.
Bahnschrift for command words, titles and numbers; Segoe UI for everything else.
Small, consistent corners (4-8px); nothing pill-shaped except switches.
Keyboard-first, right-to-left ready, local assets only.

rules.name: The Signal Means On Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo marks only what is selected, switched on, current or focused. If a thing is not in one of those states, it is not indigo.

rules.name: The No Gradient Rule
rules.body: No gradients anywhere: not on buttons, page backgrounds or highlights.

rules.name: The Red Is Not An Action Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for errors. Primary actions are Console Ink, never red, coral or amber.

rules.name: The Typed Word Rule
rules.body: Only words the user types into the palette may be set at display size.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, headers and buttons are sentence case. No all-caps labels, no tracked-out eyebrows on new surfaces.

rules.name: The Code Is Code Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for URLs, paths and identifiers; never for ordinary labels or numbers.

rules.name: The Own Direction Rule
rules.body: The page's strings are English even inside a right-to-left shell. Every sentence block (subtitles, notes, help, errors, status, the range) and every typed phrase takes its direction from its own text (`unicode-bidi: plaintext`), so punctuation, numbers and brackets stay in place; in RTL those sentence blocks still align right with their labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Anything in the page flow has no shadow. Only overlays lift.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop blur and no translucent panels; overlays are solid Sheet.

dos: Do keep surfaces flat: white Sheet on Paper with 1px Rule borders.
Do use Signal Indigo only for selected, on, current and focused states.
Do make Console Ink the colour of every primary action, one primary action per view.
Do set command words in Bahnschrift at display size and keep all other text in Segoe UI.
Do use logical properties and check every page under `dir="rtl"`.
Do make every control reachable by keyboard with a visible 2px Signal Indigo focus outline.
Do load only local CSS, JS and fonts.
Do respect reduced motion: drawers and tab bars simply appear.
donts: Don't use frosted glass, backdrop blur or translucent panels.
Don't use gradients on buttons, highlights or backgrounds.
Don't use red, coral or amber for actions.
Don't put shadows on anything that sits in the page flow.
Don't add decorative motion: no staggered entrances, bouncy easing or animations the user did not cause.
Don't use all-caps labels or monospace for non-code text.
Don't restyle the Axpert shell around AxiCMD.
